pcs.pc_description: Use suitable ppe like rubber hand gloves as required.
Put strips of paper in suitable container (drum).
Add sufficient water to drum to soak paper.
Allow it to soak for 3-4 days.
Remove the soaked paper and transfer to stone mortar.
Pound the paper with wooden pestle.
Put the pounded material under sun/shade to allow it to dry partially under open atmosphere.
Prepare separately rice flour (atiji) with dissolving of rice flour in water and mixing while heating.
Cool the atiji so formed.
Mix this atiji with partly dried pounded paste of paper. it turns into a natural adhesive called paper pulp.
Select the wooden base material developed out of hand tools of cutting and fixing by nails as per design required.
Rub out the surface to add smother finish to wooden surface.
Put varnish or some polishing material over the wooden surface.
Keep on putting paper pulp over the wooden base to develop the object of paper mache as per size and shape.
Leave it to dry for 4-5 days.
